paragraphs: R. Chanina, son of R. Yosi HaGelili. In Keitzad Meabberin and Chullin 12a, he and his brother R. Elazar were in the court of Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel, Rabbi's father, with R. Yishmael son of R. Yochanan ben Beroka. Rosh Hashanah 32a: R. Yochanan ben Beroka and R. Chanina son of R. Yosi HaGelili before Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel. Sifra, Emor; Bava Metzia 24b; Tosefta Chullin 2:2 [received chapter 12]; Jerusalem Nedarim 6:8:10 [received chapter 6, halakhah 13], have Chananyah.
